blurb: Mint Julep Experiences offers guided tours of the Kentucky Bourbon Trail®, Tennessee Whiskey Trail, and other destinations including Italy and Mexico. Guests enjoy private and public tours featuring distillery visits, tastings, culinary experiences, and transportation. They provide custom and pre-planned itineraries with expert guides and premium transportation.
